description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans clustering behavior, specifically testing client directory partition reconstruction after silo failures. It includes definitions for test classes, observer implementations, and configuration setups.

classes.name: ClientIdPartitionDataRebuildTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing client ID partition data rebuilding logic in Orleans after silo failures.

methods.name: ReconstructClientIdPartitionTest_Observer
methods.description: Test that client directory correctly reconstructs after silo failure when using observer pattern.

methods.name: ReconstructClientIdPartitionTest_Request
methods.description: Test that client directory correctly reconstructs after silo failure during a request call.

methods.name: SetupTestAndPickGrain
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, deploys the cluster, and picks a grain on a specific silo for testing.

methods.name: CreateAndDeployTestCluster
methods.description: Builds and deploys a test cluster with configured silos and clients.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleanup method to stop and dispose of the test cluster.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Internal class implementing ISimpleGrainObserver to receive and verify state change notifications.

classes.name: SiloConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo options for testing, including cluster membership and directory cache size.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client options, such as preferred gateway index.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Handles state change notification, updating internal state and releasing semaphore.

methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a state change notification within a timeout.
